scenario_1_triage.description: Deep asphalt crater on dual-carriageway road. Poses sharp wheel rim impact risk and two-wheeler skid hazard.

scenario_1_verify.explanation: Image 2 shows the exact same road section, verified by curb landmark and asphalt edge geometry. The pothole has been fully backfilled with asphalt aggregate, rolled flat, and edge-sealed.

scenario_3_verify.explanation: Bin area has been largely emptied, but significant scattered litter remains along curb perimeter. Classified as partial/borderline cleanup.
